title: feat: persistent soft token backed by encrypted .p11k
description: The soft token (slot 0) loses all keys on C_Finalize. For a developer using wolfP11 as a daily-use local key store without hardware, this means re-importing or re-generating keys every session. This epic stores soft token keys in an encrypted .p11k file at a configurable path (default: ~/.wolfp11/soft.p11k), loading keys on C_Initialize and persisting new keys on C_GenerateKeyPair or C_CreateObject. The existing keystore format and crypto are reused unchanged.
